description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between different prompting strategies—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—and their corresponding accuracy percentages and token counts. The horizontal axis displays the categories of prompting strategies: CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, listed in that order. The vertical axis on the left represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, and tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical axis on the right represents token count, labeled as “Token Count”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, and tick marks at intervals of 100. Four bars are present, each representing a different prompting strategy and colored red, orange, blue, and green, respectively. The CoT bar has a height corresponding to approximately 91.19% accuracy and a token count of 676.85. The CoD bar reaches approximately 88.50% accuracy and has a token count of 534.24. The CCoT bar extends to approximately 88.40% accuracy with a token count of 445.91. The CoUT bar reaches approximately 80.89% accuracy and has a token count of 354.46. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color, and are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis.
